page.overview:
What is Battle on Caliban?

During the early Clone Wars, a battle occurred on the moon of Caliban after General Grievous invaded it. Captured by Grievous, Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi and members of his 212th Attack Battalion allied with the native Qubeys. The Jedi and his clone troopers were able to escape after reuniting a Qubey family.
